binders: A type Ω in universe u.
An instance asserting that μ is a probability measure.
A real-valued function X : Ω → Real.
A proof that X is measurable.
hypotheses: The measure μ is a probability measure.
The function X is measurable from Ω to the Borel measurable space on Real.
conclusions: LocalDef001 μ X t equals the lower Lebesgue integral with respect to μ of the function sending ω to ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (t * X ω)).
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef001 μ X t is the lower Lebesgue integral with respect to μ of ω ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (LocalDef002 X t ω).
LocalDef002 X t ω is Real.exp (t * X ω).
Thus the conclusion is the direct expansion of LocalDef002 inside LocalDef001.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable real-valued function X on a probability space and every real t, LocalDef001 at t is exactly the extended nonnegative lower integral of exp(t times X).
